description: Django REST Framework views module defining API endpoints and viewsets for user authentication, event management, attendees, resources, schedule items, notifications, and dashboard overview in an event management application.

classes.name: CustomObtainAuthToken
classes.description: Custom user login endpoint returning auth token and user info.

classes.name: EventViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet for CRUD operations on events, including attend/unattend actions.

classes.name: AttendeeViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet for listing and managing event attendees.

classes.name: ResourceViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet for managing resources associated with events.

classes.name: ScheduleItemViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet for managing event schedule items.

classes.name: NotificationViewSet
classes.description: ViewSet for listing notifications and marking them as read.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning server status message.

methods.name: register
methods.description: User registration endpoint creating a new user.

methods.name: post (in CustomObtainAuthToken)
methods.description: Handles user login, returns auth token and user info.

methods.name: logout_view
methods.description: Logs out the authenticated user by deleting their token.

methods.name: attend
methods.description: Marks the current user as attending an event.

methods.name: unattend
methods.description: Removes the current user from event attendees.

methods.name: get_queryset (in various viewsets)
methods.description: Returns filtered querysets based on user permissions and request parameters.

methods.name: dashboard_overview
methods.description: Provides counts of user-related events, notifications, schedule items, and resources.
